description: Run, dispatch, scale and stop Nomad jobs, see their status, allocations and logs, restart allocations, drain nodes and keep Nomad Variables up to date. Start a workflow when a job, allocation or deployment fails, or a node goes down.

hashicorp_nomad_allocation_failed_trigge.description: Runs when an allocation (a copy of a job on a node) fails, after Nomad's own restarts, or is lost with its node, with the task that failed and its last message. Allocations already failed when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

parameters.description: Only allocations of this job, such as web, and its periodic and dispatched runs. Leave blank for every job.
parameters.name: job

hashicorp_nomad_deployment_failed_trigge.description: Runs when a job's deployment (a rolling update to a new version) fails, such as when new allocations don't become healthy in time, with Nomad's reason and each task group's healthy and unhealthy counts.

parameters.description: Only deployments of this job, such as web, and its periodic and dispatched runs. Leave blank for every job.
parameters.name: job

hashicorp_nomad_job_failed_trigger.description: Runs when a job ends because it failed, such as a batch job, a periodic job's run or a dispatched job that exited with an error, with its failed allocations and what they printed last. Or when any job ends, finished or stopped too. Jobs already ended when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

parameters.description: Only this job, such as web, and its periodic and dispatched runs. Leave blank for every job.
parameters.name: job

parameters.description: Leave blank to run only when a job fails. Type all to run also when one finishes or is stopped; the outcome says which.
parameters.name: include

hashicorp_nomad_node_down_trigger.description: Runs when a node (a client machine) stops answering Nomad and is marked down or disconnected, such as to page someone. Nodes already down when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

parameters.description: Only nodes in this datacenter, such as dc1. Leave blank for every node.
parameters.name: datacenter
